correction: 三晨星、光譜、策展集不是『同一個內容的三種引用方式』。它們是三套彼此獨立、舊有規則不變的選題/內容組織體系。它們可能處理不同內容集合，也可能偶爾包含同一內容；重疊不是前提，更不是模型本身。
purpose: 建立全站內容 identity/handoff 的共用底層，只解決『同一實體不要被重複建立』。這個 contract 不把三晨星、光譜、策展集合併成同一 editorial system。
ownerRule: Canonical identity belongs to the underlying content. Each editorial system independently decides what it contains according to its own old rules. Shared IDs only prevent duplication when an actual overlap occurs.

threeMorningStars.rule: Eligibility never equals selection; it does not need to mirror Spectrum or Curated Sets.

spectrum.nature: topic-selection / relational organization system governed by existing Spectrum rules
spectrum.collectionLogic: its own works/projects/content organized through Spectrum; Jerusalem 3000 is one such Spectrum work
spectrum.rule: Spectrum chooses/organizes content by its own standard; it is not metadata automatically applied to all site content.

curatedSets.collectionLogic: each set has its own proposition and member selection
curatedSets.rule: A curated set is a deliberate collection, not a view of all canonical content and not a Spectrum projection.

relationship.example: Jerusalem 3000 belongs to Spectrum. Its research resources may form a Jerusalem 3000 curated set. This does not mean the Spectrum entry and curated set are the same content organization, nor that either is automatically Three Morning Stars.

handoff.DawnLibrary: when an editorial system selects a Dawn Work, resolve to original/zh-Hant/bilingual reader
handoff.Church: when it selects Church teaching/series/event, resolve to relevant Church surface
handoff.Magazine: when it selects publication content, resolve to Magazine
handoff.Cinema: when it selects film/programme, resolve to Cinema

layoutContract.threeMorningStars: design from its own sparse selected set and old rules
layoutContract.spectrum: design from its own Spectrum corpus/rules; relational field is not assumed to cover all site content
layoutContract.curatedSets: design each deliberate collection as a composed path/set
layoutContract.prohibition: Do not build one universal content feed and render it three ways.

translationContract.rule: Translation remains a site-wide substrate and does not affect membership in any editorial system.

next: Build separate data adapters/stores for 三晨星, 光譜 and 策展集 over shared canonical resolvers; continue normalizing each system's real corpus independently.
